results.summary: Q3 FY2026: revenue $5.95B (+251% YoY, beat by 25.68%), non-GAAP EPS $23.41 (beat $14.66 consensus). Debt retired to zero. Share buyback authorized. Guided Q4 to $8B sales, gross margins rising, EPS $30-33. Stock up 13% May 5 to new 52-week high; down 4.4% May 7 on Bernstein mixed spot market signal. Up ~500% YTD.
